text:
anna: T-minus ~24h to the version bump. Quick status check: is the green sweep holding? Any outstanding branch backports we need to land before cutoff? :eyes:

mike: CI looks mostly stable, but one flaky integration on mac-builder-2 keeps failing intermittently. I retried the job twice, both failed on the same test.

ci-bot: [buildkite] build #4728 - mac-builder-2 - failed - flaky_test: tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_eviction (log: https://bk/redwood/4728)

sara: Changelog is drafted in PR #5482. I left notes on the performance section — we should call out the batching changes. If someone can give a quick review I can merge and tag.

jordan: @sara I can take changelog review in 20m. Also, heads up: we need to pin the release branch to v2.4.1-rc before bump. I created branch release/v2.4.1-rc from main and opened a small PR with the version file.

kelly: On the flaky test: I can look. That test has been a pain, likely timing related. Quick triage plan: reproduce locally in mac runner image, then add a short wait or use tolerant assertion. If we can't fix before cutoff I'll add a temporary skip with NOTE referencing the test owner.

devops-oncall: Runner health is fine overall; mac-builder-2 had a recent kernel patch yesterday but passed health checks. I restarted the Buildkite agent on that host at 09:12 UTC — might have caused transient failures. Will keep an eye.

anna: Thanks. If we can't stabilize the mac test by EOB, please do the skip-and-note approach and ping me so we can unblock the green sweep. We prefer fixes but unblock is fine for cutoff.

mike: For backports: only one hotfix needed (PR #5490) for a kube config path change. I can land it after Sara merges changelog. It's low risk.

sara: Merged changelog PR, tagged `v2.4.1-rc` locally. Pushed release branch: `git push origin release/v2.4.1-rc`.

jordan: Confirmed branch is up. Initiating bump PR now (small diff to VERSION and docs). Will add reviewers: @mike, @kelly.

kelly: Working on the flaky test now. If I can't reproduce within 30m I'll mark skip and add ticket REDWOOD-457 for proper fix.

ci-bot: [buildkite] trigger: release/v2.4.1-rc - greenwave-sweep - started (pipeline: release-sanity)

mike: Once bump PR is open, can someone kick off a manual green-sweep with `BUCKET=release-sanity ./scripts/greenwave.sh --parallel 6`? I don't want pipeline auto-queue to hold up other merges.

devops-oncall: Roger. I'll kick the sweep after Jordan's PR is up and after Kelly confirms flaky status.

kelly: Update: reproduced locally (timing), added a 200ms retry in the test harness. Pushing a tiny fix now, but I'll still add a temporary skip in case the pipeline sees more flakes.

anna: Excellent. Please leave the skip comment with: "skip: flake - temporary, see REDWOOD-457" and include link to PR in the comment.

mike: After sweep completes, let's coordinate final cutover steps in this thread: release notes, tag push, and deploy window. I'm on standby 16:00-18:00 UTC.

jordan: Bump PR opened: #5501. Description includes migration notes. Tagging reviewers.

ci-bot: [buildkite] build #4734 - release-sanity - running (tests: 120)

anna: Great. I'll take final signoff once green. Thanks all, please @mention me on the final pass. :shipit:
_meta: Generated Slack thread for release coordination: version bump, changelog merge, flaky triage, and green sweep orchestration. Contains short messages, bot notices, and action items.
